'''Guadalupe Sabio Buzo''' (born 4 June 1977) is a Spanish scientist and Professor at the [[Spanish National Cardiovascular Research Centre]], which is part of the [[Carlos III Health Institute]]. Her research focuses on stress-activated [[kinase]]s and the development of diseases associated with obesity. She was awarded the [[:es:Fundación Princesa de Girona|Princess of Girona Foundation]] Scientist Prize in 2012 and selected as one of the Top 100 Women Leaders in Spain in 2017.

== Early life and education ==
Sabio was born in [[Badajoz]] in 1977. She attended the Colegio del Santo Ángel and the Institute of San Fernando.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.hoy.es/extremadura/201612/18/vencer-obesidad-puede-dificil-20161218003101-v.html|title=Vencer la obesidad puede ser más difícil que vencer el cáncer|date=2016-12-18|website=Hoy|language=es-ES|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref> She studied veterinary sciences at the [[University of Extremadura]], and graduated in 2000 with an extraordinary award.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://investigacionfjs.com/es/jurado-guadalupe-sabio-buzo/|title=Jurado-Dra. Guadalupe Sabio Buzo|website=Premios a la investigación FJS|language=es-ES|access-date=2019-11-04}}</ref> She has said that she chose to study veterinary science as she liked animals very much, and that this could help her understand the origins of diseases.<ref name=":0" /> She moved to the [[United Kingdom]] for her doctoral studies, where she joined the [[University of Dundee]] as a [[Medical Research Council (United Kingdom)|Medical Research Council]] European graduate student. She completed her doctorate on p38 delta kinases in 2005.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ppu.mrc.ac.uk/about-us/alumni-interviews/guadalupe-sabio|title=Alumni Interview {{!}} Guadalupe Sabio|website=MRC|access-date=2019-11-04}}</ref> Whilst her PhD had taught her how to research ''in vitro'', Sabio was keen to translate her research into mouse models.<ref name=":1" /> She joined the research group of Roger Davis at the [[Howard Hughes Medical Institute]] where she studied the impact of stress on kinases proteins. In 2009 she was awarded [[Santiago Ramón y Cajal]] funding to join a biotechnology laboratory in Spain.<ref name=":1" />

== Research and career ==
Sabio joined the [[Spanish National Cardiovascular Research Centre]] in 2011.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eldiario.es/tecnologia/cientifica-Guadalupe-Sabio-obeso-ruleta_0_878762172.html|title=La científica Guadalupe Sabio: Estar obeso es jugar a la ruleta rusa|last=EFE|website=eldiario.es|language=es|access-date=2019-11-04}}</ref> Sabio is investigating the molecular mechanisms that are associated with obesity, and how they can predispose patients to other conditions such as [[hepatocellular carcinoma]].<ref name="publico.es">{{Cite web|url=https://www.publico.es/sociedad/entrevista-guadalupe-sabio-buzo-investigar-perspectiva-genero-basico-salvar-vida-mujeres-prevenir-enfermedades.html|title=Investigar con perspectiva de género es básico para salvar la vida de las mujeres y prevenir enfermedades|website=www.publico.es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://eldiadigital.es//art/285403/guadalupe-sabio-defiende-el-papel-de-la-grasa-como-organo-endocrino|title=Guadalupe Sabio defiende el papel de la grasa como órgano endocrino|last=ELDIAdigital|first=eldiadigital es|website=eldiadigital.es Periódico de Castilla-La Mancha|language=es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref> Hepatocellular carcinoma is a type of liver carcinoma, and the second most common cause of cancer-related deaths. Whilst there is [[chemotherapy]] available, it can only increase a patient's life by three months. Sabio researches p38gamma, a kinase protein that is expressed excessively in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, and whether inhibition of this protein could reduce the cancer. She is developing drugs that inhibit p38gamma for the treatment of liver cancer.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.redleonardo.es/noticias/descubren-una-nueva-diana-terapeutica-tratar-cancer-higado/|title=Descubren una nueva diana terapéutica para tratar el cáncer de hígado|date=2019-04-10|website=Red Leonardo|language=es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref> She has also investigated the [[C-Jun N-terminal kinases]] (JNK) protein, which is known to control obesity.<ref name=":0" />

She believes that obesity will be a major challenge for future generations, and it should be taken as seriously as smoking.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/salud/2019/10/27/5db16c4dfdddff1f668b4687.html|title=Guadalupe Sabio: "Hacen falta medidas más drásticas contra la obesidad"|date=2019-10-27|website=ELMUNDO|language=es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/vanguardia-de-la-ciencia/20190317/461077897492/guadalupe-sabio-obesidad-ciencia-videos-seo-ext.html|title=Peligros sobre la obesidad|date=2019-03-17|website=La Vanguardia|access-date=2019-11-04}}</ref> By considering fat, [[adipose tissue]], as an endocrine organ she believes people will think more carefully about how to care for it.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uclm.es/noticias/febrero2019/toledo/confeguadalupesabio|title=La investigadora del CNIC Guadalupe Sabio defiende en la UCLM el papel de la grasa como órgano endocrino|last=Mancha|first=Universidad de Castilla-La|website=Universidad de Castilla - La Mancha|access-date=2019-11-04}}</ref> She believes that the best antidotes to obesity are  exercise and diet.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://elpais.com/elpais/2019/07/18/buenavida/1563460348_213939.html|title=Hay muchas farmacéuticas en busca de la pastilla contra la obesidad. Pero aún no existe nada efectivo|last=Moreno|first=Ana García|date=2019-08-06|work=El País|access-date=2019-11-04|language=es|issn=1134-6582}}</ref> In 2017 Sabio was inducted into the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.redleonardo.es/noticias/guadalupe-sabio-entra-formar-parte-los-jovenes-mas-brillantes-la-embo/|title=Guadalupe Sabio entra a formar parte de los jóvenes más brillantes de la EMBO|date=2017-11-03|website=Red Leonardo|language=es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref>

Sabio has been involved in several initiatives to promote women in science.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.trendencias.com/mujeres-en-la-ciencia-1/guadalupe-sabio-presencia-minoritaria-mujeres-ciencia-algo-que-esta-empezando-a-corregir-ahora|title=Guadalupe Sabio: "la presencia minoritaria de mujeres en la ciencia es algo que se está empezando a corregir ahora"|last=López|first=Pepa|date=2019-07-19|website=Trendencias|language=es|access-date=2019-11-03}}</ref> She has called for more research into the symptoms of disease experienced by women.<ref name="publico.es"/>
